name: Puttanesca Fish and Potato Traybake

components.name: Fish & Puttanesca Vegetables

ingredients.name: Raw boneless firm white fish fillets

steps: Meanwhile combine tomatoes, fennel, onion, olives, capers, chopped anchovies, garlic, chilli flakes and oregano with the remaining olive oil.
Add the tomato-fennel mixture around the half-roasted potatoes and return to the oven another 12-15 minutes until vegetables begin softening.
Season the fish lightly, place on top of the vegetables and roast another 12-18 minutes until the thickest fish centre reaches 63 C.
Finish with lemon and parsley, then portion the fish, potatoes and tomato-olive vegetables evenly into six containers.
Cool quickly. Use earlier-week portions for best fish texture, and freeze only if acceptable after testing.

components.name: Roasted Potato Wedges

ingredients.name: Raw potatoes, cut in small wedges

steps: Heat oven to 210 C. Coat potato wedges in their measured olive oil and roast on a large tray about 20 minutes.

Dietary: Contains fish and anchovy; verify any additional fish allergens.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.
